title: Color Game
description: Adds Color Game- a gambling game inspired by it's real life origin.
body:
Ever wanted to play Color Game in your Minecraft Server? 

You can do that now by adding this plugin to your server!

# WHAT DOES THE PLUGIN DO?

Color Game is a GUI-based Casino game where you can bet your money or emeralds! 

Win and you get **double, triple or quadruple ** the amount! Lose and you get nothing :(

# PLEASE NOTE!

This plugin has a soft dependency for VaultAPI. You can download the plugin [here](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/). Otherwise, emeralds will be the default currency to bet. 

If there are bugs/issues with the plugin, join our Discord server and let me know :)
